From: aditya.rao@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:46:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Contract cap and indemnity changes — GreenBridge SOW

Team —

I've reviewed the GreenBridge redline. Summary and ask: 

- Liability cap: Customer proposes unlimited (practically $5M in the SOW). Our standard for this segment is 12 months' fees or $1M, whichever is lower. Anything above $2M requires Exec sign-off per our escalation matrix.
- Indemnity: their proposed language removes our ability to rely on mutual carve-outs for customer negligence and expands third-party claims; this materially increases litigation exposure.
- Warranty: removal of downstream disclaimers exposes us to third-party integration failures not under our control.

Mitigations to propose in a counter-offer: 
1) Use a scaled liability cap tied to subscription value: 24 months' fees capped at $2M.
2) Keep mutual indemnity but add a carve-out for customer modifications and third-party integrations.
3) Enhanced limitation of liability for consequential damages, but offer a negotiated service credit schedule as a bridge.

Approval required: legal recommends Revenue + VP-level sign-off (Markus Klein or Marissa Cole) for discounts/risk acceptance; if they approve, Executive (CFO) sign-off is required to exceed $2M cap.

Attached: GG-SOW-redline-v3.docx (marked with proposed language)

Aditya Rao
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

To: markus.klein@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Escalation: GreenBridge — approval request to accept modified cap/indemnity (GD-2389)

Markus / Marissa —

Looping you in for quick approval guidance. GreenBridge is asking for the liability cap to be raised to $5M and for broadened indemnity language on a $1.2M ARR SOW. Sales has priced a 20% discount (see attached commercial summary). Legal (Aditya) advises that >$2M cap requires Executive sign-off; Legal proposes a compromise redline (GG-SOW-redline-v3.docx) that ties cap to 24 months' fees capped at $2M with indemnity carve-outs and a service-credit schedule.

Request: 
- Can Revenue leadership accept the proposed compromise (24 months' fees / $2M cap + service-credit schedule) so we can present a counter?
- If Revenue accepts but GreenBridge insists on $5M, we will need CFO-level approval.

If you want a one-pager I can prepare a short risk vs. revenue memo; otherwise please reply with Approve / Reject / Discuss and I will action.

Attachments: Commercial_Summary_GD-2389.xlsx, GG-SOW-redline-v3.docx

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
